Remira is a human adventurer travelling with  Aradin and  Barth in Act One.
“
We're packing up and I'd advise you do the same. Seems our kind ain't welcome here.
„
— Remira

Overview

Act One

Remira is one of the adventurers who is ambushed by goblins at the beginning of Act One outside of the Emerald Grove. If she survives the battle and remains in the Grove, she is regretful and frustrated that they left their companion  Liam behind. She believes he is dead but takes solace that he died quickly.

Companion approval

Act One: Emerald Grove

If Remira survives the goblin attack on the Grove and remains in the sanctuary, the party can speak to her about Liam's fate. She informs the party that Liam charged at the goblin nest.

  • [CLERIC OF TEMPUS] A good death. He earned his place in Warrior's Rest.  +1  +1  +1

Idle banter

If Remira and Aradin survive the goblin attack on the Grove and decide to stay, they can be found chatting over drinks:

  • Aradin
    It could be worse.
  • Remira
    ... how?
  • Aradin
    Coulda been us they caught.
  • Remira
    You shouldn't have brought Liam along. Lad was too young.
  • Aradin
    Everyone needs to cut their teeth sometime.
  • Remira
    Cut his teeth?! For his sake, I hope he's dead already.
  • Remira
    What comes next?
  • Aradin
    We finish this bottle. Got enough dead to toast, anyway.
  • Remira
    Not the worst plan you've had lately.

If Remira and Barth survive the goblin attack on the Grove:

  • Remira
    Think more are coming?
  • Barth
    They got their fill.
  • Remira
    Liam isn't here...
  • Barth
    He didn't make it this far. You saw them grab him.
  • Remira
    You don't gotta remind me.
  • Remira
    We shouldn't be hanging around.
  • Barth
    Give it a rest. We have time.
  • Remira
    Maybe you do.
